correctness.rationale: The alternating empirical innovation is exact. A2Grad-uni follows by Cesàro convergence. A2Grad-inc telescopes to an exact quadratically weighted sum whose normalized second moment tends to \(G^2/3\). A2Grad-exp is a stable exponential filter of a forcing sequence tending to \(G^2\), followed by a bounded monotone envelope, so its envelope tends to \(G^2\). The source \(\gamma_k=O(k^{-1})\) term is negligible relative to all three \(h_k=\Theta(\sqrt{k})\) scales, yielding the stated step constants.

value.rationale: The source explicitly presents the quadratic-weight incremental average as a distinctive, more aggressive moving-average design. The theorem assigns that design a sharp, interpretable high-frequency constant: it yields exactly a square-root-of-three larger asymptotic adaptive inner step than the two companion variants. This compares all three source variants on the same canonical signal and isolates a concrete behavioral consequence of the paper's main moving-average innovation.
